notes: Primary research article (RSC Advances 2017); not a review, thesis or patent. record.json has is_retracted false and the PDF carries no retraction notice. No statement that the H2 values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. The H2 method is described as a 'static gas adsorption instrument' and the isotherms are in cm3/g, which I read as a static volumetric measurement; the paper does not use the word 'volumetric'. The text layer drops the minus signs (it reads '196 C'); the page images (main-01, main-03, main-08) show -196 degC. The SI (si1) holds Table S1 and Figs S1-S4 only and is not needed for any criterion.
